<thought>We need the mapped reaction SMILES (mapped_rxn) for the template that converts the given molecule (a sulfonamide with a pendant amide precursor) via amide bond formation from a carboxylic acid and an amine. To obtain it, we will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks a carboxylic acid (C‑O bond) and forms a C‑N bond (amide formation). We'll use the target SMILES and specify the bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
